# A_R7 source

- Creator: IceMaan
- Source: https://icemaan.itch.io/free-car-low-poly
- Original archive: `A_R7.zip`
- Imported source: `Body/A_R7_Body_3.fbx`
- License: CC0
- Retrieved: 2026-08-26

The original body is used as a base mesh. The project generator changes its
proportions, consolidates materials, separates Unity-facing parts, adds custom
RC wheels, antenna, hood clips, side accents, and a rear wing, then exports a
new `BlueRallyRC.fbx`.
